value.answer: Drooling, chewing on everything and fussiness are often just teething at this age. A cold teething ring or a clean finger rubbed on the gums can help. I can't see your child, so this is a guess, not a diagnosis.
value.triage: Call 811 if there's a fever (teething doesn't cause one), crying you can't settle, trouble swallowing, or they seem ill. Call 911 or go to the ER now if the drooling is sudden, or they're choking, can't speak, or have trouble breathing.
